summary: Navigation between pages of results with current page, previous/next and ellipses.
whenToUse: Long lists where users want to return to a specific position.
whenNotToUse: A few items that fit on one page.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Neighboring pages shown around the current one.

props.name: getPageHref
props.description: Renders real links (SEO, opening in a new tab).

keyboard.action: Each page is a standard button or link.

accessibility: nav landmark with a translatable name.
Every control has a full name (“Pagina 3”, “Pagina successiva”); ellipses are hidden.
responsive: Below a 420 px container only previous/next and “Pagina x di y” remain (container query).
commonMistakes: Passing an out-of-range page: it gets clamped, but fix the consumer state.
Forgetting to move focus/scroll back to the top of the list after a page change.
